request.query: An integral real number has a monic integer polynomial vanishing at it whose degree is at least two

items.name: IsIntegral
items.type: (R : Type u_1) → {A : Type u_3} → [inst : CommRing R] → [inst_1 : Ring A] → [Algebra R A] → A → Prop

items.name: IsIntegral.of_aeval_monic
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {A : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : CommRing A] [inst_2 : Algebra R A] {x : A}
  {p : Polynomial R}, p.Monic → p.natDegree ≠ 0 → IsIntegral R ((Polynomial.aeval x) p) → IsIntegral R x

items.name: minpoly.two_le_natDegree_iff
items.type:
∀ {A : Type u_1} {B : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing A] [inst_1 : Ring B] [inst_2 : Algebra A B] {x : B} [Nontrivial B],
  IsIntegral A x → (2 ≤ (minpoly A x).natDegree ↔ x ∉ (algebraMap A B).range)

items.name: NormedAlgebra.Real.exists_isMonicOfDegree_two_and_aeval_eq_zero
items.type:
∀ {F : Type u_1} [inst : NormedRing F] [inst_1 : NormedAlgebra ℝ F] [NormOneClass F] [NormMulClass F] (x : F),
  ∃ p, p.IsMonicOfDegree 2 ∧ (Polynomial.aeval x) p = 0

items.name: isInteger_of_is_root_of_monic
items.type:
∀ {A : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [UniqueFactorizationMonoid A] [inst_3 : Field K]
  [inst_4 : Algebra A K] [IsFractionRing A K] {p : Polynomial A},
  p.Monic → ∀ {r : K}, (Polynomial.aeval r) p = 0 → IsLocalization.IsInteger A r

items.name: IsIntegral.of_aeval_monic_of_isIntegral_coeff
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_4} {A : Type u_5} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : CommRing A] [inst_2 : Algebra R A] {x : A}
  {p : Polynomial A},
  p.Monic →
    p.natDegree ≠ 0 → IsIntegral R (Polynomial.eval x p) → (∀ (i : ℕ), IsIntegral R (p.coeff i)) → IsIntegral R x

items.name: minpoly
items.type: (A : Type u_1) → {B : Type u_2} → [inst : CommRing A] → [inst_1 : Ring B] → [Algebra A B] → B → Polynomial A

items.name: AdjoinRoot.isIntegral_root'
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] {g : Polynomial R}, g.Monic → IsIntegral R (AdjoinRoot.root g)
